item_name: Rothco Tactical Trauma First Aid Kit Contents
item_short_desc: Rothco's Tactical Trauma First Aid Kit Contents feature over 40 essential first aid items.
description: Rothco's Tactical Trauma First Aid Kit Contents have the same items as our Rothco MOLLE Tactical Trauma Kit (item # 8766, 8774 and 2766). Featuring over 40 essential first aid items; including a variety of bandages, medical instruments, and a blood stopper kit. Rothco's First Aid Kit is a great way to replenish your emergency supplies when needed.
